title: kernel-v1 low-cardinality metrics envelope (v1)
description: Versioned source of truth for the numeric constants that bound the observability metrics surface (task 25): the maximum number of unique Prometheus series the registry may expose and the size of the synthetic event corpus used by the cardinality audit. Tasks reference the schema path rather than hardcoding numbers inline; any number not anchored here is a plan defect. The cardinality audit replays cardinality_audit_corpus_size synthetic events through the metrics pipeline and asserts the resulting unique-series count stays at or below max_series; a run that exceeds max_series is a hard failure, not a warning.

max_series.description: Maximum number of unique Prometheus series the observability registry may expose (task 25). Labels are bounded enums only (no pid/container_id/pod_uid/path identifiers), so series count is bounded by the label-value cross product; a cardinality audit that observes more than max_series unique series is a hard failure.

cardinality_audit_corpus_size.description: Number of synthetic events the cardinality audit replays through the metrics pipeline (task 25) to prove the unique-series count stays at or below max_series regardless of input volume. The corpus size is an audit input bound, NOT a series bound; increasing it must never increase the series count past max_series.
